A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to open the continued Public Hearing for the Year 5, Permanent Local Housing
  Allocation (PLHA); approve an agreement with the Salvation Army’s Bell Shelter in a form to be
  approved by the City Attorney; and adopt Resolution No. 015­2025, approving participation in the
  Los Angeles County PLHA Program by authorizing the Mayor, or his designee, to sign a
  Reimbursable Contract with the Los Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) acting on
  behalf of the City.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor De Paula spoke.

  Mayor De Paula closed the Public Hearing.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 015­2025.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Vargas, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Del Rio
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

on Wednesday, July 9, 2025 at 6:00 PM.
